# Evan Lopez

> Evan Lopez is a stand-up comedian based in Austin, Texas. He was featured on OFTV's most-watched episode of the "LMAOF" stand-up series, hosts the weekly podcast Seven Minutes in Evan, and founded the Austin production company Top Flight Comedy.

## Who
- Evan Lopez is a stand-up comedian based in Austin, Texas.
- Featured on OFTV's most-watched episode of the "LMAOF" stand-up series.
- Has performed at Austin comedy clubs including Comedy Mothership, Cap City Comedy Club, The Creek and the Cave, Sunset Strip Comedy Club, Black Rabbit ATX, East Austin Comedy Club (a regular at East Austin Comedy Club).
- Known online for a viral comedic bird-watching series on Instagram and TikTok ("the birdyverse").
- Born in a small desert town in California; half white, half Puerto Rican; raised as a homeschool kid.
- Founder and producer of Top Flight Comedy (https://topflightcomedy.com/), an Austin comedy production company.

## Podcast
- Seven Minutes in Evan: a weekly comedy podcast hosted by Evan Lopez, 359 episodes.
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/1law6HzyxvgV1NMXmt70n2

- Recent episodes:

- Pigeons, Pedro Pascal & Parenting (2026-09-18)

- New Doomsday Trailer reaction!! (2026-07-20)
